summary: The very short source correctly trusts settled work; a portable version needs exact ticket identity, review of the actual patch, and evidence-backed completion.

supporting_disposition.reason: Preserve source UI metadata and invocation policy exactly.
Retain Matt Pocock MIT attribution in every refactored package.

deltas.change: Resolve exact work identity and accept an agreed conversation plan as input.
deltas.reason: Bare issue numbers and file-only assumptions can select the wrong work.
deltas.tradeoff: A brief start-of-work contract adds a few lines.

deltas.change: Reuse agreed seams and ask only when the missing choice affects implementation.
deltas.reason: Pre-agreed should not mean silently skipped or repeatedly reapproved.

deltas.change: Review actual task changes before committing, then resolve material findings.
deltas.reason: The source pair reviews HEAD while implement has not committed and does not act on review findings.
deltas.tradeoff: Review must support a working snapshot or a disclosed alternative.

deltas.change: Commit only task-owned changes to the intended current branch and report shared-checkout conflicts.
deltas.reason: Stage-all and competing writers can mix work.
deltas.tradeoff: Some concurrent work must be isolated or serialized.

deltas.change: Reconcile acceptance evidence and authorized tracker completion.
deltas.reason: A commit alone does not unblock a dependency graph.
deltas.tradeoff: Completion may remain partially pending when verification or tracker access is unavailable.

deltas.change: Omit Claude-only disable-model-invocation frontmatter while copying agents/openai.yaml explicit-only policy.
deltas.reason: The target is Codex packaging; its metadata preserves invocation intent and the bundled validator accepts the supported frontmatter.
deltas.tradeoff: This package is not a byte-identical Claude entrypoint.
